abi: Linux x86_64/aarch64 openat2 syscall437,24-byte open_how, RESOLVE_NO_XDEV1 | NO_SYMLINKS4 | BENEATH8; O_DIRECTORY/O_NOFOLLOW/O_CLOEXEC
capture: retained parent FD mount ID parsed once from bounded /proc/self/fdinfo under min(inherited W, supplied C) before opaque constructor
inheritance: each successful root/child openat2 forbids mount crossings including same-device bind mounts, so its retained mount identity equals its already-bound parent; no after-C fdinfo/statx/proc read
failure: unsupported ABI/syscall, unavailable mount identity, EXDEV, root identity mismatch or uncertainty fails closed; no weaker openat fallback
post_C: only bound descriptor-relative metadata/enumeration/removal and descriptor close; retained original-CWD fchdir+close; no contents/proc/hash/progress/model/new durable evidence
kernel_execution: not performed by implementer; availability and outcomes remain Main/validator-owned
